metadata.title: Mulberry compote
metadata.description: It’s mulberry season, and I couldn’t resist making a quick compote — just fresh mulberries, a touch of sugar, a squeeze of lemon juice, and a splash of water. Simple, vibrant, and so versatile — perfect on toast, pancakes, or even with yogurt
